workflows.title: From research question to reviewed dossier
workflows.businessGoal: Make research decisions reproducible and easier to review
workflows.implementation: reference/demo_model.mjs; host wiring remains to be implemented

steps.title: Check dataset
steps.action: Validate timestamps, counts and chronological boundaries.

steps.title: Declare the study
steps.action: Fix question, split and comparison before results are calculated.

steps.title: Accept the study plan
steps.action: Review the fixed experiment scope in this demo.

steps.title: Compare the methods
steps.action: Calculate local synthetic forecast errors and retain exact inputs.

steps.title: Review evidence
steps.action: Check scope, provenance, held-out partition and result limitations.

steps.title: Prepare the dossier
steps.action: Assemble accepted evidence with its limitations; no publication action.

workflows.refusalPath: Keep the failing transition unchanged, show error code/reason and route to the responsible role.
workflows.outcome: A synthetic reviewed dossier, with no claim of real-world predictive performance.

workflows.title: Data revision invalidates current evidence
humanDecisions: New study review and independent result review are required
workflows.refusalPath: Old runs remain historical; revised data is unchecked and current approvals are cleared.
workflows.outcome: No stale result presented as accepted current evidence.
workflows.businessGoal: Keep review decisions tied to the exact current evidence.
workflows.trigger: A data steward supplies a revised synthetic dataset.
